title: New Content Pill
summary: Holds new feed items behind a "5 new posts" pill, so the feed doesn't jump under the reader's finger while they read or tap.
description: Live feed wrapper that holds new arrivals behind a "5 new posts" pill that inserts and scrolls up on tap, inserting directly only when the reader is at the top and not mid-press. Works in its own scroll box or with scrollTarget="window".
catches: Posts shifting under a tap when new items arrive
Inserts directly when the reader is already at the top
limits: Assumes a newest-first list where new items arrive at the start
Needs a stable key per item (getKey)
a11y: Pill is a button; the count is announced via role=status
After tapping, focus moves to the first feed item without scrolling past it
Smooth scroll and the pill animation are skipped under reduced motion
stops: Feed jumped while I was tapping
